content.title: Chapter 14 - ANIMALS — Sec. 14-224. - Renewals.
content.summary:
Renewal of an existing license granted pursuant to this article may be had by payment
               of the yearly license fee and filing of a renewal application with the city clerk
               not less than 45 days prior to the date of expiration.
